coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across six major angles: (1) Data visualization market sizing and analyst coverage (Gartner, Technavio, Fortune Business Insights, Mordor Intelligence, Market Research Future); (2) Workflow orchestration and data pipeline tools ecosystem (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, n8n, comparative analyses); (3) AI agent builders and low-code/no-code platform landscape (Gartner LCAP Magic Quadrant leaders, emerging vendors, market forecasts); (4) Graph database visualization and node-link diagram tools (Neo4j ecosystem, Cytoscape.js, D3.js, knowledge graph visualization); (5) Complementary markets (RPA/enterprise automation, DataOps, observability, vector databases, embedded analytics, internal tools); (6) HCI and cognitive research on graph/network visualization effectiveness and design principles. Deduplication rationale: consolidated multiple vendor announcements into single authoritative sources; multiple market report vendors (Gartner, Technavio, IMARC, Polaris, Emergen, Grand View, Mordor, etc.) covering same markets deduplicated to highest-tier sources; academic research aggregated by topic (node-link cognition, force-directed algorithms, taxonomy visualization). Sources span analyst reports (T0-T1), peer-reviewed HCI research (T1), official product documentation (T1-T2), and reputable practitioner essays (T2-T3). Notable coverage: SQL/database market trends (PostgreSQL/MySQL), Angular 17 adoption, streaming visualization, dashboard design patterns, data engineer pain points (primary survey data). Gaps deferred: (1) Patent landscape analysis for graph visualization methods (USPTO references included but not deep-mined); (2) Customer acquisition cost and retention metrics by platform; (3) Deep competitive pricing matrix analysis; (4) User behavior/session analytics from product telemetry; (5) Niche verticals (pharma, biotech knowledge graphs, scientific workflow systems).
